evals.name: port-untyped-example
evals.prompt: In the sszvis repo, apps/new-docs/examples/bar-chart-horizontal/basic/chart.ts is supposed to be a TypeScript example but it isn't really typed. Please port it properly so it's a good example for people to copy. Don't edit the repo copy - write your result to the output directory.
evals.expected_output: A ported chart.ts using sszvis.app<State>(), named Datum/State interfaces, typed parseRow, no /* global */ pragma, config.id instead of hardcoded selector, wired fallback, no resize registration inside render.

evals.name: review-example-for-issues
evals.prompt: Can you review apps/new-docs/examples/line-chart/basic/chart.ts in the sszvis repo and tell me everything wrong with it as a documentation example? Write your review to the output directory as review.md.
evals.expected_output: A review identifying the highlightTick(isSelected) closure bug, sszvis.compose type erasure, absence of type annotations, and correctly attributing responsiveProps/measureDimensions errors to library type defects rather than the example.

evals.name: author-new-example
evals.prompt: I want to add a new example to the sszvis docs: a horizontal bar chart showing Zurich district populations, with a tooltip on hover. Write me the chart.ts and example.json. Put them in the output directory.
evals.expected_output: A new example with the canonical banner sections, sszvis.app<State>(), typed Datum/State, config-driven id/data/fallback, tooltip wired through createHtmlLayer, and a matching example.json.
